svg.title: Star and orbiting brown dwarf with AD 3116B secondary eclipses
svg.desc: An orange host star and an orbiting brown dwarf on the left, with a dashed orbit and orange arrows indicating the brown dwarf's emitted light, beside the March 21 and March 23, 2026 Palomar light curves stacked on the right. Plots extracted directly from Figure 3, panels e and f.
